description: This file defines interfaces, constants, types, and macros for the CAN (Controller Area Network) module in an AUTOSAR-based Arctic Core platform, including configuration structures, error codes, service IDs, and callback function prototypes.

methods.name: Can_Init
methods.description: Initializes the CAN module with the provided configuration.

methods.name: Can_InitController
methods.description: Initializes a specific CAN controller with the given configuration.

methods.name: Can_SetControllerMode
methods.description: Sets the mode of a specified CAN controller (start, stop, sleep, wakeup).

methods.name: Can_DisableControllerInterrupts
methods.description: Disables interrupts for a specified CAN controller.

methods.name: Can_EnableControllerInterrupts
methods.description: Enables interrupts for a specified CAN controller.

methods.name: Can_Write
methods.description: Sends a CAN PDU through a hardware transmit handle.

methods.name: Can_Cbk_CheckWakeup
methods.description: Checks if the CAN controller has a wakeup event.

methods.name: Can_MainFunction_Write
methods.description: Main function for handling CAN write operations.

methods.name: Can_MainFunction_Read
methods.description: Main function for handling CAN read operations.

methods.name: Can_MainFunction_BusOff
methods.description: Main function for handling bus-off events.

methods.name: Can_MainFunction_Error
methods.description: Main function for handling error events.

methods.name: Can_MainFunction_Wakeup
methods.description: Main function for handling wakeup events.

methods.name: Can_Arc_GetTestInfo
methods.description: Retrieves test information for CAN, if enabled.
